restrictions: No full collision is exhibited or computed. The package is a distribution-free classical birthday argument for every fixed function from a 2^512-element domain to 256-bit strings.

The selected target is complete SHA3-256 with the Keccak-f[1600] permutation reduced to its first 6 rounds, standard multi-rate padding, and all 256 output bits. It is not a raw-permutation, free-start, or truncated-output result.
Matching uses stable 8-pass 32-bit LSD radix sort on two flat record arrays, plus one 2^32-word count array. There is no merge sort, hash table, expected-time filter, or multiplication primitive.

Charged time is H+W/1626 under collision-frontier-v5. The submitted 132.8 is a proved ceiling of that envelope, not a unit-price reading of the operation table and not an improvement of the nominal 128-bit reference.
